mainEntity.name: When should I consider a functional layout improvement project for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a functional layout improvement project if your current home no longer meets your lifestyle needs or if you find certain areas difficult to use efficiently. Common triggers include a growing family, working from home, or wanting to update an outdated floor plan that restricts movement or light. Often, clients realize the need when preparing for a kitchen or bathroom remodel, as that's an opportune time to reassess the entire space. Thinking about how you use each room daily can highlight areas that could benefit from a more functional design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a functional layout improvement when your home no longer meets your lifestyle, if spaces are inefficient, or during a larger renovation like a kitchen or bathroom remodel.
